thesis: This episode argues that platform owners (like Microsoft and Meta) typically win when use cases are intrinsically linked to their ecosystem, while specialized AI applications may struggle to build broad markets without a platform foundation. It suggests that existing IT services companies (like Tata and Infosys) could leverage AI to significantly increase revenue from current contracts, whereas pure-play AI firms face questions about their ability to scale across diverse industries.
